internal_capacity_equation: For every node side, q[t+1]=q[t]+accepted_source_valid[t]-source_pop[t], with 0<=q<=64. Native write is offered valid, so q==64 && valid && !pop is a fault, not refusal. Root input q<=128; held unmatched entries<=128. Downstream bridge cannot repair a violated internal bound.

A-priority return service; input writes/pointer increments not suppressed on full. Root adder result blocks queue service. Full queues/held slots raise sticky faults without producer ACK/ready.

Each asserted rom_we updates vm using low VM_AW bits at the following edge; postNBA visibility and all competing writers must be witnessed, including address-bound checks.
